_description: Settings of the Observation request page (trigger_app.py). Rows are appended to the worksheet '<period>_<Project ID>' of spreadsheet_url. specmodes null = the public Spec list (data/public_modes.json). Exposure times above max_exptime are errors, any value other than default_exptime is a warning. hidden: columns written with fixed values (comment = the Project ID). The Google service-account key is found through data/settings.json (google_service_account_key), the GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS variable or TCSpy's googleSheet.config.
